## 1) Buscando um catalogo

```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as pl
```

```{python}
# $ pip install astroquery

from astroquery.vizier import Vizier
```

```{python}
#| collapsed: true

Vizier.find_catalogs?
```

```{python}
catalog_list = Vizier.find_catalogs('NOMAD')

print(catalog_list)
```

```{python}
type(catalog_list)
```

```{python}
for k,v in catalog_list.items():
```

## 2) Buscando um objeto
<a id="pt2"></a>

```{python}
#| tags: []
result = Vizier.query_object('NGC322', catalog='Gaia')

print(result)
```

```{python}
# Acessando o catálogo de interesse, usando o indice

interesting_table = result[7]
print(interesting_table)
```

```{python}
# Acessando o catálogo de interesse, usando o identificador

interesting_table = result['I/358/vclassre']
print(interesting_table)
```

# Buscando Keywords especificas de um catalogo e aplicando filtros

```{python}
v = Vizier(catalog='I/297/out', keywords=['optical'])

result = v.query_object('HD 226868')
print(result)
```

```{python}
type(result)
```

```{python}
print(result['I/297/out'])
```

```{python}
df = result['I/297/out']
```

```{python}
df
```


```{python}
type(df)
```

```{python}
df.keys()
```

```{python}
df['Jmag']
```

```{python}
# Podemos escolher quais colunas queremos pegar e aplicar filtros
v = Vizier(columns=['RAJ2000', 'DEJ2000', 'Vmag', 'Bmag','B-V'], catalog='NOMAD',
           column_filters={'Vmag':'>10'}, keywords=['optical'])
```

```{python}
result = v.query_object('HD 226868')
print(result)
```

```{python}
print(result['I/297/out'])
```

```{python}
df = result['I/297/out']
```

```{python}
df
```

```{python}
df['B-V'] = df['Bmag'] - df['Vmag']
```

```{python}
df
```

## 3) Buscando uma região
<a id="pt3"></a>

```{python}
v = Vizier(#columns=['_RAJ2000', '_DEJ2000','B-V', 'Vmag', 'Bmag'], 
           catalog='I/297/out',
           column_filters={'Vmag':'>10'}, keywords=['optical'])
```

```{python}
#| tags: []
v.query_region?
```

```{python}
#| tags: []
import astropy.units as u

result = v.query_region('299.561497200	35.201692200', radius=10*u.arcmin)
print(result['I/297/out'])
```

```{python}
result['I/297/out'].keys()
```

```{python}
# Note que o resultado é sempre uma tabela com 50 elementos, concidencia?
v.ROW_LIMIT
```

```{python}
v.ROW_LIMIT = 100
```

```{python}
result = v.query_region('299.561497200	35.201692200', radius=10*u.arcmin)
print(result['I/297/out'])
```

```{python}
v.ROW_LIMIT = 10000
```

```{python}
result = v.query_region('299.561497200	35.201692200', radius=10*u.arcmin)
print(result['I/297/out'])
```


```{python}
df2 = result['I/297/out']
```

```{python}
df2.write('output_astroq.csv', format='csv', overwrite=True)
```

```{python}
df2.write?
```

```{python}
df5 = pd.read_csv('output_aq.csv')
```

```{python}
df5
```

```{python}
# Levando o catálogo para o Pandas
```
